result:
All 14 queries ran against the input files and gave sensible answers. I didn't check V1–V5 or V9–V12 against the data by hand, and I never checked V11's null-assignee test against an issue with no `assignee` key.

- **V1:** the total comes out as 165.48.
- **V6:** the tags on at least 2 lines are core, io, net, parser and util.
- **V13:** the top two regions are east (140) and south (77.47).
- **V14:** the result is `ANN|CY|DORA|FRED`.

V13 reads the CSV by splitting each line on commas, so it would break on quoted fields. The sample file has none.

V1: get /data/orders | filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
V2: get /data/orders | groupBy ~(coalesce /customer/country "unknown") | map ~(count)
V3: filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(get /roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin")) | sort ~(get /name | lower) | map ~(get /name)
V4: map ~(coalesce /age null) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
V5: map ~(coalesce /address/city null) | filter ~(ne null) | map ~(lower) | toSet | sort
V6: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split ":" | drop 1 | join ":" | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | filter ~(ne "") | distinct) | flat | groupBy | map ~(count) | filter ~(gte 2) | keys | map ~(toString) | sort
V7: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split " " | get [/1 /2]) | filter ~(get /0 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(get /1) | groupBy | map ~(count)
V8: lines | filter ~(contains "req=") | filter ~(contains "duration=") | map ~(get {:r (capture #"req=(?<r>\S+)" | get /r) :d (capture #"duration=(?<d>\d+)ms" | get /d | toNumber)}) | sort ~(get /d | desc) | take 3 | map ~(get /r)
V9: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | entries | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | sort | join ","
V10: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce /assignee/login "unassigned") | map ~(map ~(get /number) | sort)
V11: any ~(allOf (get /state | eq "closed") ~(get /assignee | eq null) ~(get /labels | map ~(get /name | lower) | contains "bug"))
V12: :d (get /defaults/timeout) | get /services | filter ~(coalesce /enabled null | ne false) | map ~(coalesce /timeout d)
V13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split "," | get {:region /0 :u (get /3 | if (eq "") ~(0) ~(toNumber)) :p (get /4 | toNumber)} | get {:region /region :rev (mulOf /u /p)}) | groupBy ~(get /region) | map ~(map ~(get /rev) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100) | entries | map ~(get {:region (get /0 | toString) :revenue /1}) | sort ~(get /revenue | desc) | take 2
V14: "1:ann:82;2:Bob:69;3:cy:70;4:dora:91;5:Ed:55;6:fred:70" | split ";" | map ~(split ":" | get [/1 /2]) | filter ~(get /1 | toNumber | gte 70) | map ~(get /0 | upper) | sort | join "|"
